source_snapshot.procedure: Enable debug/error-injection BIOS settings, deploy Intel ITP/CScripts, boot Windows, halt, call injectUpiError(socket, port, num_crcs=0, stopInj=False, cleanErrors=yes), resume and collect evidence.
source_snapshot.criteria: Requires matching OS dmesg, BMC fatal UPI log, front-panel fault LED, recovered UEFI SEL and optional LCD CPU Over Temp indication.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; leaves injection to an FAE but proposes Linux dmesg and truncated SEL capture after a Windows boot.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; unresolved infinite-stop semantics, Windows/dmesg conflict, LCD mapping and recovery make execution unsafe.

old_problem: The source combines an effectively continuous UPI CRC injection with no stop step, boots Windows but requires dmesg, and expects a CPU Over Temp LCD message for a UPI fault. Exact harness semantics, topology, signatures and emergency recovery are unapproved.
disposition_reason: ED-16 requires an approved RAS tool, isolated SUT, deterministic oracle and recovery. The absent stop path and contradictory OS/LCD criteria affect core safety and PASS semantics, not merely runtime identifiers, so ED-03 cannot resolve them. Execution is therefore BLOCKED until the Intel/platform authority supplies a bounded injection and recovery contract; Pending remains without inventing evidence.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 6 and 7, including the BIOS paths, exact injection call, Criteria and DeepSeek fields.
Read GPT V2/historical record 2412 and retained exact source identity and hashes.
`stopInj=False` with no later stop operation can create a persistent error stream; a timeout alone does not prove the injector was disabled.
Windows boot makes Linux dmesg an invalid default oracle unless the owner supplies a distinct recovery environment and correlation procedure.
CPU Over Temp is not inherently equivalent to a UPI CRC fatal indication and cannot be declared expected without an approved platform mapping.
No BIOS change, ITP connection, injection, reset, power cycle, log clear or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Bounded Intel UPI CRC infinite-error RAS path validation
test_case.purpose: Under qualified FAE control, exercise the intended sustained UPI CRC fault on every approved socket/port target and verify the authorized Windows, BMC, recovered UEFI and applicable physical-indicator response without leaving injection or debug state active.
required_package: Approved SUT/CPU/UPI topology and socket-port matrix
Supported Intel ITP/CScripts version/hash and authoritative injectUpiError semantics
Hard-bounded duration, positive stop verification, emergency recovery and BIOS restoration procedure
Approved Windows evidence source and exact WHEA/UPI/BMC/UEFI signatures
SKU-specific front-panel/LCD applicability and corrected message mapping
test_case.test_command: NO INJECTION AUTHORIZED YET. After approval, a qualified Intel FAE on a dedicated SUT must snapshot BIOS/log state, apply only the listed debug settings, verify the exact socket/port, run the approved ITP sequence within an externally enforced bounded window, positively stop/verify the injector, recover through the approved path, collect complete Windows/ITP, BMC, UEFI and physical evidence, and restore every setting. Agent activity is limited to approved read-only evidence capture.
test_case.expected_result: UNRESOLVED pending authoritative signatures and message mapping. The future PASS contract must prove the intended UPI CRC event on the exact target across all applicable evidence planes, bounded termination, healthy recovery and complete BIOS/debug-state restoration, with no unrelated thermal fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS is allowed until the stop/recovery method, Windows-compatible oracle and LCD/LED applicability are approved. Absence of dmesg on Windows, an uncontrolled persistent injector, an unrelated over-temperature event, missing evidence, failed recovery/restoration or any unapproved reset/retry is not PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle isolated SUT, stable power, independent console and qualified Intel FAE/operator are mandatory.
Preserve pre-state logs and settings; do not clear evidence before capture.
Require a hard injection bound, positive stop verification and aborts for lost control, error storm, hang, thermal/power anomaly or no-boot.
Do not auto-retry, autonomously reset/power-cycle or restore debug settings outside the approved recovery sequence.
expected_evidence: Row/variant/hash, approval and full SUT/CPU/socket/UPI identity
Harness hash, exact socket/port, complete ITP transcript and bounded start/stop proof
Pre/post BIOS settings and restoration comparison
Complete approved Windows/ITP, BMC SEL and recovered UEFI SEL evidence
Timestamped LED/LCD evidence with SKU applicability and message mapping
test_case.recovery: Engineering must approve an independent-console stop and recovery sequence that positively disables injection, returns the platform to a known bootable state, preserves all fault evidence and restores each BIOS debug setting. No reset or power cycle is inferred or automatically attempted.

source_conflict.reason: Windows versus dmesg, infinite injection without a stop step and UPI CRC versus CPU Over Temp LCD semantics remain unresolved source-level conflicts.

blocked.reason: The missing positive stop, emergency recovery and authoritative oracle make fault injection unsafe and unverifiable under ED-16.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Approved topology/harness semantics, bounded duration and positive stop, emergency recovery/restoration, Windows-compatible signatures and SKU-specific LED/LCD mapping.
pending.execution_status: BLOCKED; STATIC REVIEW ONLY; NO RAS OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Intel FAE, platform RAS/BIOS owner and testcase owner.
pending.unlock_condition: Approve all tool, isolation, oracle, stop and recovery contracts, then issue a versioned review-layer revision before execution.

project_authority: The platform RAS specification and Intel FAE-approved ITP/CScripts procedure are authoritative for injection semantics, signatures, indicators and recovery.
